messages:
alyssa: quick check — looking for an owner to finalize the error-insights view for the new Console dashboard. Goal: ship canary by EOW. We need a retention decision for trace logs (30 vs 90 days), sampling guidance, and a code review for the frontend + trace-hook PRs. @sam @raj any volunteers?

raj: I can take infra + retention config. Heads up — staging exporter's connectivity is currently failing due to a recent egress rule tweak. I'll open a small infra PR to revert/fix unless @eng-sre objects.

sam: I can review the frontend and trace-hook PRs today. Ping me when PRs are up — aiming to complete review by 12pm PT.

mara: product prefers 90 days for error-analysis. But to control cost let's combine 90-day retention with sampling for older traces. Proposal: `retention_days: 90` + `trace_sample_rate: 0.15`.

alyssa: noted @mara, thanks. @raj can you post the exact k8s/manifest snippet you'll change and call out any blast-radius? Need to know if this touches other teams' exporters.

raj: opening PR now, will attach manifest and logs. snippet for staging egress that I changed back:
```
# staging egress fix (manifest excerpt)
- name: ALLOW_EXPORTER
  ports: [9411, 9412]
  to: 10.0.3.0/24
```
Will cc @eng-sre. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/422

deploy-bot: Staging deploy failed for console-observability (build 583) — exporter's init container timed out (connectivity). Logs: connect timeout to 10.0.3.6:9411

owen: if rolling back infra quickly is risky, we can gate the new trace hook behind a feature flag and fallback to the aggregated errors view (no raw traces). That keeps the UI usable for the canary.

sam: agree with fallback. I'll add a quick feature-flag check in the frontend: `if (!tracesEnabled) showAggregatedErrors()` and include a minor CSS tweak so empty trace panes don't look broken.

raj: PR is up: infra/pull/422 — includes manifest + rationale. I also added a `trace_sample_rate: 0.15` parameter to the console configmap as optional so we can flip it without redeploying code. Tagging @sam @mara for visibility.

sam: reviewing now, will comment inline and post a summary once done.

deploy-bot: Staging deploy succeeded for console-observability (build 584) — exporter connected and traces flowing.

alyssa: awesome, thanks everyone. @raj please merge the infra PR after eng-sre gives thumbs-up. @sam please drop a short review summary + any follow-ups (e.g., telemetry metrics we should add). I'll consolidate decisions (90d retention + 0.15 sample_rate, feature-flagged traces) into the roadmap doc and ping security for the retention policy. :thumbsup:
